capabilities: Publish flagged notes and their embedded images to a GitHub repository
Rewrite ![[image]] embeds to relative image paths and co-locate assets per note
Preview new, changed, unchanged, and failed notes before uploading
Write gh-published and gh-published-url status back into note frontmatter
Mark or unmark the active note for publishing via a command
disambiguation: Not a Git backup or version-control tool for the vault; it publishes only flagged notes to a repo and never deletes or syncs the whole vault.
extras: The GitHub token is stored in plaintext in the vault's data.json, which the README warns about; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Design inspired by oleeskild/obsidian-digital-garden, but lighter: it only syncs files
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push selected notes and their co-located images to a GitHub repository for use with a static-site generator or as a Markdown archive.

relations.evidence: Design inspired by oleeskild/obsidian-digital-garden, but lighter
publishes vault notes together with their images to a GitHub repository
It currently pairs smoothly with the Amytis digital garden setup.

requires.name: GitHub token with Contents: Read and write
GitHub account and an existing initialized repository

summary: Publishes notes flagged gh-publish: true, with their embedded images, to a GitHub repository as Markdown files, incrementally and in one atomic commit.
